HELP_PAGE.TITLE: Help & support
HELP_PAGE.SUBTITLE: Need help? Check the FAQ or contact the StudHub team.
HELP_PAGE.FAQ1_Q: How do I edit my profile?
HELP_PAGE.FAQ1_A: Go to Profile → Edit profile. You can change your name, phone, university, study level and bio.
HELP_PAGE.FAQ2_Q: How do I contact an agent or seller?
HELP_PAGE.FAQ2_A: From a listing, use Messages or Call. Conversations appear in the Messages tab.
HELP_PAGE.FAQ3_Q: How do I favorite a listing?
HELP_PAGE.FAQ3_A: Tap the heart on a listing. Find them later in Favorites from your profile.
HELP_PAGE.FAQ4_A: Make sure notifications are allowed for StudHub in your phone settings.
HELP_PAGE.FAQ5_Q: How do I report an issue?
HELP_PAGE.FAQ5_A: Use the form below or email support@studhub.tn. Include as much detail as possible.

PRIVACY_PAGE.TITLE: Privacy & security
PRIVACY_PAGE.SUBTITLE: Manage your preferences, account and read our policy.
PRIVACY_PAGE.POL1_BODY: StudHub collects information needed for the service: name, email, phone, university, and activity related to listings (favorites, messages). We do not sell your personal data.
PRIVACY_PAGE.POL2_BODY: Your data is used to create your account, connect students, improve the app and keep it safe (fight abuse and scams).
PRIVACY_PAGE.POL3_BODY: We may share limited information with technical providers (hosting, push notifications) only to run StudHub. Business partners do not access your personal data without your action.
PRIVACY_PAGE.POL4_BODY: You can edit your profile, request account deletion or ask a question via Help & support. Contact: support@studhub.tn.
PRIVACY_PAGE.LOGOUT_MESSAGE: You will need to sign in again to access your account.
PRIVACY_PAGE.DELETE_HINT: Permanent: listings, messages and data will be erased.
